name: AO-7
note: Launched in 1974 and still working, but only in sunlight. Linear transponder for SSB and CW.
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: AMSAT, with radio amateurs in the US, West Germany, Canada and Australia
profile.story: AMSAT-OSCAR 7 is the oldest amateur satellite still working. It fell silent in 1981 when its batteries failed, then came back in 2002 when a shorted battery cell went open. With no battery it runs straight off its solar panels: it works in sunlight and restarts, sometimes in a different mode, each time it comes out of eclipse.
